다음 트랙가사관련 항목

sections.①:
• 브랜드명: YouTube Music
  • 한 줄 정체성: 뮤직비디오 + 오디오 트랙이 하나로 흐르는 YouTube 기반 음악 스트리밍
  • 공식 디자인 철학: YouTube Material You 톤 — 다크 우선·콘텐츠 풀블리드
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: 검정 캔버스 + YT Red(#FF0033) + 풀스크린 가사(노트 아이콘 + 큰 볼드 텍스트)로 곡 위로 흐르는 라이브 자막. Apple Music이 SF Pro 무드라면, YT Music은 비디오·뮤직 하이브리드
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 비디오우선, 가사몰입, 다크
  • 무드 설명: 거의 검정. 곡 재생 시 비디오와 오디오를 토글할 수 있고, 가사 탭은 큰 타이포로 곡과 함께 스크롤된다. 빨강은 재생·구독 신호에만.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀
  • 밀도(Density): Comfortable
  • 모서리 성향: Round (8~12px)
  • 평면성: Layered — 모달·미니플레이어에 미세 그림자
sections.③:
:root {
  /* Primary - YouTube Music Red */
  --color-primary-50:  #FFE6EB;
  --color-primary-100: #FFB8C5;
  --color-primary-200: #FF8294;
  --color-primary-300: #FF4D67;
  --color-primary-400: #FF2548;
  --color-primary-500: #FF0033;   /* YT Music Red */
  --color-primary-600: #CC0029;
  --color-primary-700: #99001F;
  --color-primary-800: #660015;
  --color-primary-900: #330009;

  /* Secondary - Lyric warm gradient hint */
  --color-secondary-500: #FF6B7A;

  /* Neutral - YT dark scale */
  --color-neutral-0:    #FFFFFF;
  --color-neutral-50:   #F9F9F9;
  --color-neutral-100:  #F2F2F2;
  --color-neutral-200:  #AAAAAA;
  --color-neutral-300:  #717171;
  --color-neutral-500:  #4F4F4F;
  --color-neutral-700:  #272727;       /* card */
  --color-neutral-800:  #1F1F1F;       /* surface */
  --color-neutral-900:  #0F0F0F;       /* sidebar */
  --color-neutral-1000: #030303;       /* canvas */

  /* Semantic */
  --color-success-bg: #E6F4EA;
  --color-success-fg: #1E8E3E;
  --color-warning-bg: #FEF7E0;
  --color-warning-fg: #F9AB00;
  --color-error-bg:   #FCE8E6;
  --color-error-fg:   #D93025;
  --color-info-bg:    #E8F0FE;
  --color-info-fg:    #1A73E8;

  /* Surface */
  --bg-base:     #030303;
  --bg-subtle:   #0F0F0F;
  --bg-elevated: #1F1F1F;
  --bg-overlay:  rgba(0,0,0,0.80);

  /* Text */
  --text-primary:    #FFFFFF;
  --text-secondary:  #AAAAAA;
  --text-tertiary:   #717171;
  --text-on-primary: #FFFFFF;
  --text-disabled:   #4F4F4F;

  /* Border */
  --border-default: #272727;
  --border-subtle:  #1F1F1F;
  --border-strong:  #3F3F3F;
  --border-focus:   #FF0033;
}
sections.④:
• 폰트 페어링:
    • 영문: YouTube Sans / Roboto 폴백
    • 한글: Noto Sans KR / Pretendard
  • 위계:
    • Display: 56px / 700 / 1.1 / -0.02em (가사 풀스크린)
    • H1: 32px / 700 / 1.2 / -0.01em
    • H2: 22px / 700 / 1.25 / -0.005em
    • H3: 16px / 600 / 1.4 / 0
    • Body Large: 16px / 400 / 1.5 / 0
    • Body: 14px / 400 / 1.45 / 0
    • Body Small: 12px / 500 / 1.4 / 0
    • Caption: 11px / 600 / 1.3 / 0.04em uppercase
    • Lyric: 28~40px / 700 / 1.35 / -0.01em (시그니처)
sections.⑦:
--shadow-none: none;
--shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.30);
--shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
--shadow-lg: 0 16px 36px rgba(255,0,51,0.30);  /* 앨범 글로우 */
--shadow-xl: 0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.60);
sections.⑧:
• 스타일: Material Symbols (Outline + Filled 토글)
  • Stroke 굵기: 2px
  • 모서리 처리: Round
  • 추천 라이브러리: Material Symbols / Phosphor 폴백
sections.⑨:
Button

.btn { font: 600 14px/1 'YouTube Sans', Roboto, sans-serif; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease; }
.btn-primary { background: #fff; color: #000; }      /* 흰 버튼이 메인 */
.btn-primary:hover { background: #E5E5E5; }
.btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #fff; }
.btn-danger { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.btn-subscribe { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }   /* 시그니처 빨강 */
.btn-disabled { background: var(--color-neutral-700); color: var(--text-disabled); }
.btn-play { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; color: #000; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 22px; }

Input

.input { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 18px 10px 40px; color: #fff; font: 400 14px/1.2 inherit; }
.input::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary); }
.input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary-500); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

Card (Track)

.track { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; }
.track:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
.track .cv { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#FF0033,#7A0820); }
.track h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 14px/1.3 inherit; color: #fff; }
.track .by { font: 400 12px/1.3 inherit; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px; }
.card { background: var(--bg-elevated); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 16px; }
.card-outlined { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); }

Badge / Tag

.tag { padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 11px/1.4 inherit; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tag-solid   { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.tag-subtle  { background: rgba(255,0,51,0.16); color: var(--color-primary-300); }
.tag-outline { border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); color: #fff; }
.tag-music   { background: #fff; color: #000; }   /* MUSIC VIDEO 토글 */

Navigation (Sidebar)

.sidebar { width: 240px; background: var(--bg-subtle); padding: 12px; }
.sidebar .item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 14px/1.3 inherit; color: var(--text-primary); cursor: pointer; }
.sidebar .item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
.sidebar .item.active { background: rgba(255,0,51,0.16); color: var(--color-primary-300); }
sections.⑩:
--duration-fast: 150ms;
--duration-base: 250ms;
--duration-slow: 400ms;
--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1);     /* Material Standard */
--ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1);
--ease-lyric: cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1);    /* 가사 슬라이드 */
sections.⑪: 1. 가사 디스플레이를 작은 본문 폰트로 렌더링 금지 — 큰 볼드 라이브 자막이 시그니처 2. 메인 액션을 빨강 버튼으로 사용 금지 — 흰 버튼이 메인, 빨강은 구독·재생 신호 3. 라이트 모드를 기본 캔버스로 사용 금지 4. 카드 모서리 sharp(0px) 사용 금지 — 8~12px Round 5. 영상 썸네일을 무시한 오디오만 UI 금지 — 영상/오디오 토글이 정체성
sections.⑫:
<style>
  .ytm-demo {
    min-height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    background:
      radial-gradient(900px 520px at 78% 8%, rgba(255,0,51,.18), transparent 64%),
      var(--bg-base);
    font-family: 'YouTube Sans', Roboto, 'Pretendard', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  }
  .ytm-topbar {
    height: 64px;
    padding: 0 var(--space-lg);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-lg);
    background: rgba(3,3,3,.82);
    backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  }
  .ytm-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; white-space: nowrap; }
  .ytm-mark {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    background: var(--color-primary-500);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  }
  .ytm-mark::before {
    content: '';
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    border: 2px solid var(--text-on-primary);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    background: linear-gradient(30deg, transparent 41%, #fff 42% 58%, transparent 59%);
  }
  .ytm-search {
    width: min(420px, 42vw);
    margin-left: auto;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.07);
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .ytm-avatar {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg,#7348ff,#ff477e);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 800;
  }
  .ytm-shell { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-lg) var(--space-3xl); }
  .ytm-chips { display: flex; gap: var(--space-sm); margin-bottom: var(--space-xl); overflow: hidden; }
  .ytm-chip {
    padding: 8px 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font: 600 12px/1 inherit;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ytm-chip:first-child { background: var(--text-primary); color: var(--bg-base); }
  .ytm-hero { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr minmax(300px,440px); gap: clamp(28px,6vw,78px); align-items: center; }
  .ytm-kicker { margin: 0 0 var(--space-sm); color: var(--color-primary-300); font: 700 12px/1.2 inherit; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .ytm-hero h1 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(42px,7vw,78px)/.96 inherit; letter-spacing: -.055em; }
  .ytm-hero-copy { max-width: 540px; margin: var(--space-lg) 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 16px/1.65 inherit; }
  .ytm-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-sm); }
  .ytm-player {
    position: relative;
    padding: var(--space-md);
    background: linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.12),rgba(31,31,31,.78));
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
  }
  .ytm-toggle {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    top: var(--space-lg);
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    display: flex;
    padding: 3px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    background: rgba(3,3,3,.72);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }
  .ytm-toggle span { padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
  .ytm-toggle .active { background: var(--text-primary); color: var(--bg-base); }
  .ytm-cover {
    aspect-ratio: 16/11;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    position: relative;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, #ff4367 0 6%, #930020 6% 11%, transparent 12%),
      repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#161616 0 13px,#2d2d2d 14px 16px),
      linear-gradient(145deg,#ff0033,#27050e 70%);
  }
  .ytm-cover::after {
    content: 'OFFICIAL VIDEO';
    position: absolute;
    left: 12px;
    bottom: 12px;
    padding: 5px 7px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: rgba(0,0,0,.72);
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
  }
  .ytm-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-md); padding: var(--space-md) 2px var(--space-xs); }
  .ytm-meta-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .ytm-meta h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 17px/1.2 inherit; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
  .ytm-meta p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; }
  .ytm-play {
    width: 46px;
    height: 46px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    background: var(--text-primary);
    color: var(--bg-base);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-size: 17px;
  }
  .ytm-progress { height: 3px; margin-top: var(--space-sm); overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--color-neutral-500); }
  .ytm-progress::before { content: ''; display: block; width: 42%; height: 100%; background: var(--text-primary); }
  .ytm-section-title { margin: var(--space-3xl) 0 var(--space-md); font: 700 25px/1.2 inherit; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  .ytm-features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: var(--space-md); }
  .ytm-feature { min-height: 220px; padding: var(--space-lg); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); overflow: hidden; }
  .ytm-feature-icon {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    background: rgba(255,0,51,.16);
    color: var(--color-primary-300);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-weight: 800;
  }
  .ytm-feature h3 { margin: 0 0 var(--space-sm); font: 700 17px/1.25 inherit; }
  .ytm-feature > p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 13px/1.55 inherit; }
  .ytm-mini-toggle { display: flex; margin-top: var(--space-lg); padding: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--bg-base); }
  .ytm-mini-toggle span { flex: 1; padding: 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); color: var(--text-secondary); text-align: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
  .ytm-mini-toggle .active { background: var(--text-primary); color: var(--bg-base); }
  .ytm-lyric { margin-top: var(--space-lg); font: 700 18px/1.35 inherit; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
  .ytm-lyric .now { display: block; color: var(--text-primary); }
  .ytm-track-list { margin-top: var(--space-md); }
  .ytm-track-list .track { padding-inline: 0; }
  .ytm-track-list .track .cv { width: 38px; height: 38px; }
  .ytm-track-list .track:nth-child(2) .cv { background: linear-gradient(135deg,#7028ff,#ff477e); }
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .ytm-topbar { padding-inline: var(--space-md); }
    .ytm-search { display: none; }
    .ytm-avatar { margin-left: auto; }
    .ytm-shell { padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-md) var(--space-2xl); }
    .ytm-hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .ytm-hero h1 { font-size: 46px; }
    .ytm-features { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
